method: Roundups of user-visible changes introduced through first-parent merges into production. Remote production heads were checked with git ls-remote. Dates are roundup cutoffs, not deployment confirmations. Frontend and backend readiness were considered together. Internal refactors, CI, secrets/configuration changes, and unverified performance claims are omitted.
coverage: April 1 through September 30, 2026. Frontend history covers the full interval; the supplied backend repository begins April 25 and its first staging-to-production PR is May 8. Earlier backend claims cannot be established from this repository.

changes.text: **Tailor a dashboard report.** Choose filters and add instructions when creating a report, so it focuses on the audience and data you need. [Export dashboard reports](/dashboards/how-to/export-dashboard-reports).
**Take your results with you.** Export a chart as a PNG image or a table as a CSV file for use outside Supaboard.

**Explore the data behind a result.** Dashboard filters now carry into drill-down views, and source labels help you see where the records came from. [Explore dashboard data](/dashboards/how-to/explore-dashboard-data).
**Choose where an embedded dashboard opens.** Set its starting page and hide the page selector when viewers only need that view. [Embed a dashboard](/dashboards/embedding/overview).
Chart axis edits now appear in the widget, and undoing or canceling dashboard edits restores the expected state.
A new conversation appears in your chat list after its first message.

**Review a seat charge before changing access.** A charge preview helps you understand the cost before promoting a workspace member. Invoices appear newest first. [Manage workspace access](/workspace/invite-and-manage-access).
**Paste an attachment into a question.** Add supporting material directly to your message without starting from the upload picker.

Database connection forms handle passwords containing special characters more reliably, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Snowflake connections. [Connect a data source](/data-sources/connect-a-data-source).
Filters carry through more reliably when opening underlying records from tables and KPI widgets.
Invoices that previously failed to open can now be viewed.

**Build a dashboard from a request.** Describe what you want to see and review the proposed plan before the dashboard is generated. The plan carries its title and summary into the dashboard. [Create a dashboard](/dashboards/how-to/create-a-dashboard).
**Find actions with a keyboard shortcut.** Open the command palette with **⌘K** on Mac or **Ctrl+K** on Windows to find pages and common actions.
**Share a conversation or a specific answer.** Sharing controls give teammates a link to the chat, with message links opening at the relevant answer.
**Work with PDFs and presentations in context.** Preview these files inside Supaboard. AI chat can read their text and retain previously attached files for follow-up questions.
**Keep large pivot tables readable.** Group by a second field and show the top results with the remainder collected into “Other.” [Table settings](/dashboards/widgets/table-widget).
**Ask how to use Supaboard.** AI chat can consult the documentation to help with product questions.
Inviting someone who already has a Supaboard account no longer fails in the existing-user invitation flow.
**Start a new query without an empty-state error.** The query editor initializes correctly before you begin editing. [Create a query](/query-bench/create-and-save-a-query).
**Run older saved analyses against the right connection.** Analyses using an earlier saved-query format can resolve their data source correctly.
**Explore an agent’s knowledge visually.** An interactive graph shows how items in its knowledge base relate to each other. [Configure an agent](/agents/overview).
**Read clearer AI summaries.** Answers use cleaner prose, and the assistant can recover from more situations where a clarification previously led to a dead end.
AI-generated queries identify database tables by their actual names, reducing failures caused by an incorrect table reference.
Fivetran setup no longer creates duplicate data sources in the affected connection flow. [Connect with Fivetran](/data-sources/connectors/fivetran).
Connection setup accepts display names containing spaces, and upgrade prompts no longer appear repeatedly in the connector flow.
**Keep required filters in an analysis.** Additional checks help the assistant retain the filters from a verified query when building on it.
**Edit table columns with missing values.** Column settings no longer fail when the available value list is missing or empty. [Table settings](/dashboards/widgets/table-widget).
**Let an automation ask about a dashboard.** Add a step that uses the dashboard to answer a question. [Create an automation](/automations/create-an-automation).
**Choose a path based on a result.** Conditional branches let an automation take different next steps when its conditions are met.
**Edit with fewer interruptions.** Automation changes save automatically, and you can insert a new step between existing steps.
**Pass more than one value between steps.** Use a whole column or multiple rows from an earlier result. Choose workspace members more easily when setting up an email step.
**Test a step with the inputs it needs.** Required earlier steps run before the selected test step.
**Explore more PostgreSQL data.** Materialized views are available alongside your other database tables and views.
Scheduled automations avoid duplicate runs in the affected scheduling flow, and deleting an automation also removes its leftover steps.
Drilling into grouped results respects combined filter conditions more accurately.
**Wrap long column headings.** Turn on **Wrap header titles** in table settings to show the full name without making every column wider. [Table settings](/dashboards/widgets/table-widget).
**Explore grouped tables with less clicking.** Expand all groups and move through pages of grouped results.
**Export the current table view.** CSV exports respect active filters, visible columns, and the column order you chose.
Timestamp labels display correctly in the affected charts.
Refreshing a data source makes its updated table structure available immediately, and browsing later pages of records no longer skips the wrong number of rows.

**Create reports that work across several pages.** PDF generation plans the document page by page and reviews it across pages for consistency. [Reports and presentations](/artifacts/reports-and-presentations).
**Use analysis results in presentations.** Presentation generation receives structured data for its charts and tables, helping the document stay aligned with the analysis.
**Build an automation by chatting.** Describe the workflow you need and work with the AI assistant to build its steps. [Create an automation](/automations/create-an-automation).

**Schedule dashboard reports.** Choose the recipients, timing, filters, and report format, including Excel. You can also send a summary without a report attachment. [Schedule dashboard reports](/automations/schedule-dashboard-reports).
**Take a dashboard snapshot.** Export the dashboard as a PDF with the data and filters in the current view. [Export dashboard reports](/dashboards/how-to/export-dashboard-reports).
**Keep filters when building with AI.** Automation steps created from a dashboard use its actual filters.
Weekly and monthly schedules use the selected timing more reliably.
A failed AI summary no longer makes successfully fetched data appear to be empty.
**Group related columns under one heading.** Column groups and an aggregate footer help readers understand a wide table and its totals. [Table settings](/dashboards/widgets/table-widget).
**Set up the view your readers need.** Open row groups by default, choose group-header colors, and use conditional text colors to highlight values.
Accepting an SQL autocomplete suggestion no longer duplicates or joins characters incorrectly in the affected editor flow. [Query Bench](/query-bench/overview).
Building and testing automation branches handles branch state more reliably.

**Ask questions using the dashboard’s existing results.** The assistant makes better use of dashboard widgets before querying the underlying connection for additional information. [Dashboard insights](/dashboards/insights-in-dashboard).

**Keep related filters in sync.** Filters whose available choices depend on another selection now update more reliably, including in embedded dashboards. [Dashboard filters](/dashboards/filters/how-to-add-filters-to-your-dashboard).
HTML results show a loading state while their content is being prepared.

**Click a value to filter the dashboard.** A table can become the starting point for exploring related charts. Set up the column mapping so the selection applies to the correct data. [Filter dashboards from a table](/dashboards/filters/filter-dashboards-from-table-data).
**Choose how a table opens.** Set its initial page and rows per page, or hide the pagination footer. [Table settings](/dashboards/widgets/table-widget).
**Choose automation email recipients from earlier results.** An email step can use recipient values produced by another step.
Clicking a table column without a filter mapping no longer applies an unintended dashboard filter.
Password-reset failures show a useful error message.

**Create a Datasite.** Describe the experience you want, preview it as it is built, and publish or embed it for your audience. Datasites bring interactive pages and connected data together. [Create a Datasite](/datasites/create-a-datasite).
**Stay in control while a Datasite is being built.** Stop a build when you need to change direction.

**Refine a presentation through follow-ups.** Ask for changes to an existing deck and use an uploaded reference to guide its style. Chart data and large tables are handled more reliably. [Reports and presentations](/artifacts/reports-and-presentations).
**Get help setting up an agent.** Suggested answers make the setup questionnaire easier to complete. [Set up an agent](/agents/set-up-an-agent).
PostgreSQL connections include a database named `postgres` when discovering available databases.
**Add skills to an agent.** Write or upload reusable instructions, ask AI to help draft or revise them, and preview or disable a skill when needed. [Configure agents](/agents/overview).
**Keep presentations closer to your brief.** Generation follows the requested content and structure more consistently.
Public Datasites and sign-in from an embedded Datasite handle access more reliably. [Publish and share a Datasite](/datasites/publish-and-share).
Dashboard filters work with saved queries that contain comments.
Workspace invitations can be resent when someone needs another invitation email.
**Repeat steps for each item.** Add a loop to an automation and preview individual iterations when testing it. [Automations](/automations/overview).

**Manage an agent’s connected tools.** Supported MCP connections can use a sign-in flow. Review their connection status, enable or disable individual tools, and disconnect an app when it is no longer needed. [Connect tools](/agents/tools).
**See workspace usage and set limits.** Workspace controls make it easier to review usage and manage limits for members. [Usage and billing](/workspace/usage-and-billing).
**Export a dashboard with a shortcut.** Use **⌘P** on Mac or **Ctrl+P** on Windows to open the dashboard snapshot action.
Canceling an AI response keeps the results that were already completed.
Date filters on MongoDB data return the expected records in the affected filtering flow.

**Give a Datasite your own address.** Connect a custom domain and use the setup screen to find the DNS records your domain administrator needs. [Set up a custom domain](/datasites/datasite-custom-domains).

**Manage Datasite variables.** Keep reusable settings in one place and distinguish public values from secrets used by the site’s protected requests. [Use Datasite variables](/datasites/datasite-variables).
**Sign in to private Datasites with Google or Microsoft.** Visitors can use these sign-in options when accessing a private site.
**Return to a Datasite conversation.** Separate chat threads help visitors continue an earlier discussion.
**Schedule in your timezone.** Automation triggers use the chosen timezone. Dashboards can also reload their data automatically at a chosen interval.
**Review and undo query edits.** Query history makes it easier to return to an earlier version. [Query Bench](/query-bench/overview).

**Connect databases over a private network.** IPsec VPN setup supports secure connections to self-hosted data sources. Your network administrator can use the [IPsec guide](/data-sources/security/ipsec-vpn).
A message blocked by an exhausted allowance keeps its draft and attachments so you can send it later.
Affected dashboard widgets use the correct database instead of showing an incorrect zero result.

**For teams with custom dashboard queries:** the marker for excluding a table from dashboard filters changed from `$` to `$$`. Ask the person who maintains those queries to update any uses of the old marker. [Update a query’s filter exclusions](/dashboards/filters/ignore-filtering-for-a-given-table).

**Start with the Analyst on Home.** Ask a question or describe something to build from one place. Choose **Flash**, **Pro**, or **Max**, attach files, and add existing work as context. [Ask the Analyst](/analyst/overview).
**Keep related work in a Project.** Bring chats, artifacts, and context files together around a task or team. [Organize a Project](/projects/overview).
**Find what you have created in Artifacts.** Open saved work from a shared library and continue editing it in chat. [Find and manage artifacts](/artifacts/overview).

**Work directly with results.** Open, edit, or pin charts, tables, and KPIs from an answer. Feedback controls let you mark a result as helpful or explain what went wrong. [Understand answers](/analyst/insights-in-ask-agents).
**Find an earlier conversation.** Chat search looks through conversation titles, your questions, and the answers. [Manage chats](/analyst/managing-chats).
**Create a Datasite using existing dashboard work.** The builder can reuse a dashboard as a starting point for the site.
**Explore data with updated maps and funnels.** Both visualizations have been rebuilt for the new analysis experience.
**Change settings without leaving your work.** Settings opens over the current page, making it easier to return to what you were doing.
Interrupted chats recover more reliably, and a lost connection after approval no longer leaves the request stuck in the affected flow.
KPI results preserve the intended number format and decimal precision.
The exhausted-allowance banner no longer appears incorrectly when usable purchased balance remains.
**Choose how you browse your work.** Library pages offer a grid or a sortable table, so you can scan previews or compare items in a list. [Find artifacts](/artifacts/overview).
**Share with clearer access controls.** Sharing follows a more consistent pattern across chats and artifacts. Choose who can access an item and the permissions available for that type of work.
**Choose an agent and a mode together.** The chat composer brings agent selection and **Flash / Pro / Max** into one menu. [Ask the Analyst](/analyst/overview).
**Review actions before allowing them.** Approval cards make **Deny**, **Allow once**, and **Always allow** easier to distinguish when an action requests permission.

**Configure and try an agent in one place.** Agent settings organize knowledge, tables, examples, memory, and evaluations into tabs. Use **Try in chat** to test your changes. [Configure agents](/agents/overview).
**Fit a table column to its contents.** Double-click a column header to widen it to fit the visible contents.
A link to a specific chat message jumps to that message more reliably, and repeated artifact cards are removed from affected answers.
Completed analysis results remain available if writing the final response fails. The assistant can also recover from more failed queries.
Deleting an artifact updates the interface more consistently, and text between `<` and `>` remains visible in your messages.
